import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'public_parser_protocol_0511.dart' show evaluateCapturedRow;

// Same-sample post-fix read confirmation. No RPC, wallet, DB or model access.
void main(List<String> args) {
  if (args.length != 5)
    throw ArgumentError(
      'Usage: dart --packages=.dart_tool/package_config.json tool/replay_public_compatibility_0512.dart captureFolder output.json expectedCandidateParserSha256 candidateSourceLabel baselineReplayResults.json',
    );
  final folder = Directory(args[0]);
  final parserFile = File('lib/data/direct_activity.dart');
  final before = sha256.convert(parserFile.readAsBytesSync()).toString();
  if (before != args[2])
    throw StateError(
      'Candidate parser hash changed or was not authorized ready; no replay.',
    );
  final receipt =
      jsonDecode(File('${folder.path}/fetch-receipt.json').readAsStringSync())
          as Map;
  final protocol =
      jsonDecode(File('${folder.path}/protocol.json').readAsStringSync())
          as Map;
  if (receipt['completedAtUtc'] == null ||
      protocol['method'] != 'getTransaction' ||
      (protocol['params'] as Map)['maxSupportedTransactionVersion'] != 1)
    throw StateError('Incomplete/unapproved compatibility capture');
  final protocolSha = sha256
      .convert(File('${folder.path}/protocol.json').readAsBytesSync())
      .toString();
  if (protocolSha != receipt['protocolSha256'])
    throw StateError('Protocol hash mismatch');
  final baseline = jsonDecode(File(args[4]).readAsStringSync()) as Map;
  final oldRows = {
    for (final row in (baseline['rows'] as List).cast<Map>())
      row['caseId']: row,
  };
  final rows = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final groups = <String, Map<String, int>>{};
  for (final selected in (receipt['rows'] as List).cast<Map>()) {
    final old = oldRows[selected['caseId']]!;
    if ((old['selectionInfo'] as Map)['signature'] !=
        (selected['selectionInfo'] as Map)['signature'])
      throw StateError('Selection changed');
    final row = evaluateCapturedRow(selected, folder);
    final env = jsonDecode(
      File('${folder.path}/${selected['transactionFile']}').readAsStringSync(),
    );
    row['responseTransactionVersion'] = env is Map && env['result'] is Map
        ? (env['result'] as Map)['version']
        : null;
    row['baselineFetchState'] = old['fetchState'];
    row['baselineParserInvoked'] = old['parserInvoked'];
    row['baselineActivity'] = old['activity'];
    row['previouslyAvailableActivityUnchanged'] = old['parserInvoked'] == true
        ? jsonEncode(old['activity']) == jsonEncode(row['activity'])
        : null;
    final activity = row['activity'] as Map?;
    final outcome = activity == null
        ? '${row['fetchState']}/${row['evaluationState']}'
        : '${activity['status']}/${activity['type']}';
    final group = groups.putIfAbsent(
      'epoch${row['epoch']}/${row['program']}',
      () => {},
    );
    group[outcome] = (group[outcome] ?? 0) + 1;
    rows.add(row);
  }
  if (rows.length != 36 || oldRows.length != 36)
    throw StateError('Same36 protocol invariant');
  final after = sha256.convert(parserFile.readAsBytesSync()).toString();
  if (after != before)
    throw StateError('Candidate parser changed during replay');
  final versions = <String, int>{};
  for (final row in rows) {
    final key = '${row['responseTransactionVersion']}';
    versions[key] = (versions[key] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  final result = {
    'scope':
        'Post-fix exact-same36 public RPC read-compatibility confirmation, not held-out/independent accuracy/currentowner liveapp flow/newtrade.',
    'candidateVersion': '0.5.12+19',
    'candidateSourceLabel': args[3],
    'candidateParserFileSha256': before,
    'baselineVersion': '0.5.11+18',
    'baselineAppSource': '0c5dfd70243940d6598804e9ff3d111ae920051d',
    'baselineProtocolSha256': protocol['baselineProtocolSha256'],
    'baselineFetchReceiptSha256': protocol['baselineFetchReceiptSha256'],
    'protocolSha256': protocolSha,
    'completedFetchAtUtc': receipt['completedAtUtc'],
    'selectionPositions': rows.length,
    'uniqueSignatures': receipt['uniqueSignatures'],
    'duplicateSelectionPositions': receipt['duplicateSelectionPositions'],
    'parserInvoked': rows.where((r) => r['parserInvoked'] == true).length,
    'listingFailedPositions': rows
        .where((r) => r['listingFailed'] == true)
        .length,
    'previouslyUnavailableNowReplayed': rows
        .where(
          (r) =>
              r['baselineParserInvoked'] == false && r['parserInvoked'] == true,
        )
        .length,
    'previouslyAvailableActivityChanged': rows
        .where((r) => r['previouslyAvailableActivityUnchanged'] == false)
        .length,
    'classifiedProofFailures': rows
        .where(
          (r) =>
              r['classifiedProof'] is Map &&
              (r['classifiedProof'] as Map)['allChecksPass'] != true,
        )
        .length,
    'responseVersions': versions,
    'perEpochProgramOutcomes': groups,
    'rows': rows,
  };
  File(args[1]).writeAsStringSync(
    '${const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(result)}\n',
  );
  stdout.writeln(
    jsonEncode({
      for (final k in [
        'selectionPositions',
        'parserInvoked',
        'listingFailedPositions',
        'previouslyUnavailableNowReplayed',
        'previouslyAvailableActivityChanged',
        'classifiedProofFailures',
        'responseVersions',
        'perEpochProgramOutcomes',
      ])
        k: result[k],
    }),
  );
}
